items.question: How many people are coming to the conference?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“How many people are coming to the conference?”，自然应答是“Registration's still open.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（Registration's still open.）。
